practice_nether.goal: Speedrun practice from the portal kit: you start with an iron pickaxe, sword, shield, chestplate, golden boots, 2 buckets, flint_and_steel and cobblestone. Get into the nether (!speedrunNether), then get blaze rods (!collectBlazeRods). Every command result ends with your next step, so go straight on to it.

practice_opening.goal: Speedrun practice from nothing to the nether: get wood, stone tools, an iron pickaxe and the portal kit, then get into the nether. Every command result ends with your next step, so go straight on to it.

practice_kit.goal: Speedrun practice from the iron pickaxe: get the gear and portal kit (!speedrunKit), then into the nether (!speedrunNether). Every command result ends with your next step, so go straight on to it.
